scientific_integrity: Finite direct enumeration is a check and not a general proof. The unrestricted statements are derived using part-action compatibility, labeled chain decompositions, rook-poset inversion, and a sharp cyclic-word bound. Complete bipartite and all-multipartite square-zero special cases are previously covered, not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: The exact coefficient expression is finite but is not a simple closed product.
The largest-index formula and spanning-chain count assume every part size is at least two.
Independent validation has not been performed.
A general colored partial-permutation enumeration not located in the inspected literature might imply portions of the result.
title: Rook-Möbius rank–index census of nilpotent multipartite partial isometries
